regulations.enforcement_body: Individual Dukes County towns (Edgartown, Oak Bluffs, Tisbury, etc.)
regulations.notes: Martha's Vineyard towns began implementing STR restrictions in early 2025 to address the housing crisis. Some towns impose limits on rental frequency or minimum residency requirements. Massachusetts state STR tax (5.7%) plus local option excise (up to 6%) apply. Each of the 6 island towns may have different rules — no island-wide standard exists.
regulations.pending_legislation: Multiple town-level STR ordinances being adopted in 2025
